visual_action: Kamala Harris, wearing a black suit and white blouse, smiles and waves as she walks through a cheering crowd at an outdoor event at night. Supporters hold up signs, including one that says "USA". She walks to a podium bearing the seal of the Vice President of the United States, smiles, and claps before leaning into the microphones to speak.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Kamala Harris is the sole focus of the video, shown walking through a crowd and speaking at a podium. The on-screen text refers to her as 'our future president'.

spoken_summary: Most of the video's audio is a music track. At the very end, Kamala Harris says, "Good evening, America!"
audio_music: An upbeat, inspirational synth-pop track ('feel like we used to' by Zimmer90) plays throughout the video, creating a celebratory and forward-looking mood.
editing_pacing: The video is a montage with smooth cuts between different angles of Kamala Harris at the event.
central_claim: Kamala Harris will be the future president of the United States.
intended_effect: To inspire hope and build support for Kamala Harris as a future presidential candidate.
